readingReview.comparison: My order matches the first reader's and the script. The first reader's concerns: (1) Raman and Priya are unnamed. I accept this: the source does not name them, and in the art they read as two patients identified by appearance (glasses and stick; ponytail and coral kurti), which stays the same from 03-1/03-2 to 03-5. (2) The Ravi = A-12 link needs to be visible. Resolved: the left-to-right seating follows the check-in order, Ravi sits nearest the TV, and in 04-1 he is the one who stands at 'NOW · A-12' beside empty chairs. (3) The page is all narration and reads like a feature walkthrough. The art carries the acting: Raman's and Meera's smiles, Priya's cheerful stride, Ravi's focused scan, and the three satisfied upward looks. This is the source's design, not a reading break. (4) 'his own phone' resolves to Ravi. Nothing unresolved.
